# Dialogue tools

Lint, preview and control branching dialogue.

3 tools in the `dialogue` category. Badges: **read-only** tools never change the project; **mutating** tools are undoable and attributed; **open-world** tools reach outside the engine and MCP clients ask before running them.

| Tool | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`dialogue_check`](#dialogue_check) | Lint a .dialogue script (Yarn-style): syntax errors with line numbers, jumps to missing nodes (with did-you-mean), a missing start node, unreachable nodes, variables read but never set, empty nodes. |
| [`dialogue_preview`](#dialogue_preview) | Simulate a conversation without UI or play mode and get the transcript: every line (speaker, text, tags), each choice offered and taken, commands sent, node jumps, final variables and visit counts. |
| [`dialogue_control`](#dialogue_control) | Drive a live conversation in play mode (enters play-paused when editing, like sim_control step): start a node, advance (finishes the typewriter first), choose an option (0-based), stop, or read the state (speaker, line, choices, typing). |

### `dialogue_check` { #dialogue_check }

**Check dialogue** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--ro" title="Never changes the scene">read-only</span>

Lint a .dialogue script (Yarn-style): syntax errors with line numbers, jumps to missing nodes (with did-you-mean), a missing start node, unreachable nodes, variables read but never set, empty nodes. Also lists nodes (lines, choices, jumps), variables and custom commands (each becomes the Wander event "dialogue:<command>"). Run it after writing or editing dialogue. Format: nodes are `title: Name` / `---` / lines / `===`; lines are `Speaker: text #tag #portrait:name`; choices are `-> text` with indented bodies; commands <<set $x to 1>>, <<if $x > 1>>..<<elseif>>..<<else>>..<<endif>>, <<jump Node>>, <<wait 1>>, <<stop>>, <<any_command args>>.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string |  | Script file (project-relative .dialogue) |  |
| `source` | string |  | Script text (instead of path) |  |
| `entity` | integer \| string |  | Entity whose dialogue component's script to check |  |
| `start` | string |  | Start node (default "Start") |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    dialogue_check {"path": "story/intro.dialogue"}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call dialogue_check '{"path": "story/intro.dialogue"}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "dialogue_check",
        "arguments": {
          "path": "story/intro.dialogue"
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `dialogue_preview` { #dialogue_preview }

**Preview dialogue** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--ro" title="Never changes the scene">read-only</span>

Simulate a conversation without UI or play mode and get the transcript: every line (speaker, text, tags), each choice offered and taken, commands sent, node jumps, final variables and visit counts. `choices` picks options in order by 0-based index or by a text fragment; when they run out the preview stops at the pending choice and lists it. Use it to test branches and variable logic. Example: {"path": "story/intro.dialogue", "choices": [0, "refuse"], "vars": {"trust": 2}}

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string |  | Script file |  |
| `source` | string |  | Script text |  |
| `entity` | integer \| string |  | Entity with a dialogue component |  |
| `start` | string |  | Start node (default "Start" or the component's startNode) |  |
| `choices` | integer \| string[] |  | Choices to take, in order |  |
| `vars` | object |  | Initial variables (names without $) |  |
| `max_steps` | integer |  | Safety limit (default 500) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    dialogue_preview {"path": "story/intro.dialogue", "choices": [0, "refuse"], "vars": {"trust": 2}}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call dialogue_preview '{"path": "story/intro.dialogue", "choices": [0, "refuse"], "vars": {"trust": 2}}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "dialogue_preview",
        "arguments": {
          "path": "story/intro.dialogue",
          "choices": [
            0,
            "refuse"
          ],
          "vars": {
            "trust": 2
          }
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `dialogue_control` { #dialogue_control }

**Drive dialogue** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Drive a live conversation in play mode (enters play-paused when editing, like sim_control step): start a node, advance (finishes the typewriter first), choose an option (0-based), stop, or read the state (speaker, line, choices, typing). Events reach Wander on the next tick (on dialogue "choice", "end", "<command>").

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | yes | What to do | `start` `advance` `choose` `stop` `state` |
| `entity` | integer \| string |  | Dialogue runner entity (default: the first with a dialogue component) |  |
| `node` | string |  | start: node to start at (default: the component's startNode) |  |
| `choice` | integer |  | choose: 0-based option index |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    dialogue_control {"action": "start", "entity": "Vale"}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call dialogue_control '{"action": "start", "entity": "Vale"}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "dialogue_control",
        "arguments": {
          "action": "start",
          "entity": "Vale"
        }
      }
    }
    ```
